rivers and oceans; and ten heavens with regions and (120) places and districts and houses and towns and tribes and lands and borders and guards and gates; thresholds, (125) turns and double hours and walls; and a zodiac with planets and stars and (130) the two chariots of the sun and the moon with houses and thrones and gates and a chief gate guard; and prison master and border guard master (135) and house master and town master and tribe master and land master; and all kinds of things in the universe, (140) - then that Newsbringer god (the Call) and Informer god (the Answer), whom the One of Female Form (Mother of Life), the mother of Ohrmezdbay (First Man), [and had draped over] (145) their own bodies, were *both [led up] and were placed before that Land-master (Splenditenens) who stands above the whole heaven (150) and holds the head of those gods(?). {Two lines left blank}

(155) {y.8} And the god Mihr and the One of Female Form, the creators, were both led up to paradise and, together with (160) Ohrmezdbay and the Most Pleasing of the Lights (Friend of the Lights) and the Creator-of-the-New-World god (Great Builder), stood (165) in reverence before the ruler of Paradise. And they bowed and did deep homage and said, (170) “We greet you, lord, who by your own miracle power and blessing created us. And through us you have bound the Az and Ahrimen (Prince of Darkness) (175) and demons and witches. [ ... bring forth a new god who] shall [ ... (180) ... {y.9} ... and] command [him] that he shall go and inspect that prison of the demons; and (that) he shall apportion revolution and movement to (185) the sun and the moon and (thus) be {(200)} a deliverer and redeemer of that light and good grace of the gods (the Living soul), which in the beginning was smitten (190) through Āz and Ahrimen and the demons and the witches - and even now they keep it oppressed -, and also that (195) which is enclosed in the earth and the sky throughout the various regions and suffers pain; and (that) he should prepare a road and path up to the highest for the wind, water, and fire!” (205) End of the

speech about the corporeal (?). {Four lines left blank} | (211) Beginning of the speech of god Naresah.

{y.10} Then the ruler of paradise by his own miracle (215) power and blessing created the three gods: god Realm of Light (Third Messenger) and the god Wisdom and Power (Jesus the Splendor), (and) He Who Leads Up (Column of Glory), so that, (220) just as the lord is himself the ruler of paradise and holds all the light in it, thus that (225) god Realm of Light should be lord and ruler over the earth and heaven and hold (all) the light in the universe, (230) and (so that the three) should reveal day and night. {Two lines left blank}

(235) {y.11} And the god Wisdom and Power ... that light and good grace (the Living Soul) that after the ... [had ... {A gap of unknown length} ... ]

{y.12} <... and by the semen of the archons> plants, flowers and meadows and azihr and various growing things (240) were sown and grew. And Az herself mingled her own self into them.

{y.13} And that one part (245) that fell on the ocean - an ugly, ravenous, and fearful monster came of it, and it crawled out of the ocean (250) and began to do harm in the world. {Two lines left blank}

{y.14} Then the god Mihr sent, from among (255) those five gods of his own creation (his fve sons), that four-shaped one (Adamas), who stretched out that monster in the northern district, (260) from east to west, in the entire north, stamped his foot (on it), and threw (it down). And (265) he stood upon it, so that it could do no harm. And that god was made town-master over the entire earth [and heaven], the universe, (270) [over north and] east, south and west, in order that he should protect the world.

{y.15} And when that (275) salacious and *man-consuming Az fell from heaven onto the earth, on dry and wet land, it befouled it with all kinds of weeds and (280) monsters from its own self. {Two lines left blank}

{y.16} Then the demons and the witches,

bipeds and quadrupeds, winged and poisonous and *reptilian - (290) all those who were pregnant from hell in the beginning and then were bound in the eleven heavens - saw the brilliance and splendor of the god Realm-of-Light (Third Messenger), (295) and they lusted for him and lost their minds. Then their own misbirths (300) were *aborted from them and came down to the earth and began crawling upon the earth. And they ate food and fruit from the trees and became bigger and (turned into) monsters and Archons. And from the food and fruit of the trees that Az came into them, and they were agitated by lust and copulated together.

{y.17} Then the god Realm of Light (320) told the god Creator of the New World, "Go and build beyond the earth and heaven (and) the universe and (325) within those five hells toward the south, from there in this direction over the hall of darkness, from (330) east to the western district, similar to paradise, a new building! And in the middle of (335) that building make {(340)} a firm prison for Āz and Ahrimen and the demons and the witches! And then, when that light and good grace of the gods, which Ahrimen and the demons had devoured and is tormented and turns around in (345) every region and (in) the demons and the witches - that, after it is purified and is pulled up (350) to the highest and (when) the renovation comes about, then Az and Ahrimen and the demons and the witches shall be bound in (350) that prison for ever *beyond recovery! {Two lines left blank}

(360) {y.18} And on top of that new building make the new paradise, where Ohrmezd and these (365) gods who by their own miracle power and light seized and bound Āz and Ahrimen and the demons and the witches. (370) And for us [make] a throne and [ ... ] And [ ... ... ]

{y.26} [ ... when] the day is completed in those 30 revolutions of that (655) second threshold, then the month of Āban is attached and becomes visible. And in the month of Aban the day is 11 hours and the night 13. And then too in the universe the sun glitters and shines. {Two lines left blank}

{y.27} And then too (670) the sun rises from that second threshold to the first threshold, which is higher, larger, and (675) thicker than the others. And another thirty days of the month of Ādūr (are) those same (680) 30 revolutions and the 360 double hours he fitted into (685) that same first threshold that the moon [ ... ] [R/ii] dwelt in. And also the month of Adūr is opposite demonesses: (690) parching, scorching, and dark, and the sign of the Twins moves in it. And he opens (695) the heat from them downward. And plants and fruits begin to ripen. And then, during those 30 days of the month of Adur, (700) the 360 "seconds" that are in one full hour, day by day 12 "seconds" are taken again (705) from the night and are added to the day in their (proper) place. And (thus) the day is 12 hours, and the night 12. (710) And they are both equal. And then {(715)} the whole universe is again summer and at mid-day it is noon, which (720) was how the sun moved at the beginning.

{y.29} And afterward he divides one year into 12 monthlies corresponding to the 12 signs (of the zodiac) into spring and summer, (725) fall and winter, and makes (them) visible. And trees bloom and meadows and grass (730) and fruits and plants ripen, and the animals procreate.

(735) {y.30} And when the sun highest in the sky in that *expanse of the universe, month after (740) month move above and opposite the (five) signs of Aries, Taurus, the Twins, Cancer, and Leo, then, corresponding to (745) these five signs during five months those five days are added: for (each) sign, each month one day, the one that they (750) now consider the five gahs in Iran. In Non-Iran, as well, corresponding to these five signs severally ten days (755) are added: to each sign two days.

{y.31} And in the same manner the sign of Virgo: in one month one day is added. (760) That is when it starts to release coldness *increase discoloring, and fall (begins) to be reckoned, (765) and the universe (begins) to be sunset.

{y.32} And in the same manner the sign of Pisces: in one month one day is added. That is (770) when it begins to release warmth down from it, and the trees (begin) to bloom, and spring (begins) to be reckoned, and (775) the universe (begins) to be dawn.

{y.33} Those are, then, the five days that they now consider the five gahs in Iran (780) and the 12 days (used) in Non-Iran.

{y.34} For in that breadth of the cosmos through (the revolution of) the year and the cycle of the sun in five months, from the month (785) Mihr to the month Vahman, the summer [is ... ] (away from ?)

[M7984 I/V-R/Hd.] Discourse on Gehmurd (and) Murdiyanag

[M7984 I/R/i]
{y.35} ... at first(?), he will pull [ ... out of?] Ahrimen and (790) the demons (and) up from the universe and lead (it) up to the sun and the moon and convey (it) to its own family (795) in paradise. And then the universe will be restored. And Az and the demons (800) will be undone, and for the sun and the moon and the gods there will be rest and repose. {Two lines left blank}

(806) {y.36} And at first, too, when these gods, by the turning and (810) movement and increasing and decreasing of the sun and the moon, divided (the universe) up by regions, places, and borders and (when) they made visible (815) days and nights and months and years and (they) {(820)} purified the light out of the universe, then that accursed (lit .: whose offspring is smitten) Az, who had fallen down from heaven and (825) had donned trees and plants as garments, (thereby), from the trees and plants, (also) donned those throw-offs, the monsters and the Archons, who (830) had fallen from heaven. And that splendor and excellence of god Narêsah, (835) [ ... ] was [ ... ] and they saw [ ... ] And again he saw the sun and the moon move, (840) and similarly he saw that light and good grace of the gods too, which he kept grasped, the god and (845) the sun and the moon were continuously purifying it out of the Az and the universe and preserving it in his chariots and conveying it to paradise. (850) The decreasing of day and night {Four lines left blank}

(855) Gehmurd and Murdiyanag

{y.37} Then that *lusty Az was filled with rage, and it began to seek a way out and (860) thought, "I will form two creatures, male and female, after those two forms, male and female, of god Narêsah (865) to be a garment and covering for me [which] I will be arranged *in [so that ... (870) and] these [two] *creatures may not be taken from me and I may not endure need and distress." (875) {Two lines left blank}

{y.38} Then that Az, of all those misbirths

of the demons that had fallen from (880) the heaven onto the earth, that Archon who was male and that Archon who was female, lion-(885)-shaped, *lusty, raging, sin(ful) and thievish, those it donned as a garment. And it (890) made them its own covering and garment and lusted inside them.

{y.39} And just as in the beginning in that dark (895) hell, its own devilish abode, Āz itself had taught the demons and witches, the raging devils, the monsters and the Archons, male and female, (900) lust and coitus, thus, afterward too, Az again began to teach in the same manner lust and coitus to those other monsters and Archons, (905) male and female, who had fallen from heaven down to earth, (910) so that they should lust and copulate and mingle with their limbs together (915) and outlandish misbirths should be born from them and Az should take those misbirths and eat them and make two forms out of them, (920) one man and one woman.

{y.40} Then that monster and

[M7982 R/i]
(925) the male and female Archons taught lust and coition to all of them, and (930) they mingled together with the limbs together. And their misbirths were born and raised. And they gave their own misbirths to those two (935) Archons, the male and female of lion form, which had been created as garments for Az and full of desire, (940) and Āz devoured those misbirths. And those two Archons, the male and female, lusted and (945) mingled together with limbs together. And that shape which they had donned as garments, from those (950) misbirths of the monsters and Archons which it had eaten, that it formed after its own desire, and it made (955) a body in male shape with bones, tendons, flesh, veins, and skin.

{y.41} And it bound that (part) of (960) the light and good grace of the gods that the misbirths of the monsters had infiltrated through the fruits and êwar (965) in that body as soul. And it placed inside it its own desire, lust and, copulation (970) and animosity and bad-mouthing, hate and sin,

rage and *pollution and tidar and mindlessness and antireligionism and (975) doubt, thieving and lying, robbing and evil-doing, obstinacy and (980) chaburagi, vengefulness and chêbag, sorrow and despair, pain and ache, poverty and destitution, illness and old age, stench (985) and 'prgyy.

{y.42} And all those words and sounds of those aborted monsters, from which it shaped that body, those it gave to that animal creation, so that it should speak and know various words.

{y.43} And (the new creation) was also formed and shaped after that male appearance (995) of the gods that it had seen from the chariot, and, (1000) from above, it connected {(1005)} to it from the heaven (its) beginning from and attachment to the monsters and Archons and the star signs and the planets, so that from the monsters and the star signs desire and sin should rain upon it and fill its (1010) mind (nous), so that it would become even more thieving and monstrous and filled with concupiscence and lust. And when that male creature was born, then it named it (1015) "first man," that is, Gehmurd (living dead). {Two lines left blank}

{y.44} And then the (1020) two lion-shaped Archons, male and female, again ate of the same misbirths who assisted them (before) and (1025) lust and copulation filled them, and they mingled together with the limbs together.

{y.45} And that Az which had filled (1030) them through those misbirths of the monsters that they had eaten, that once more shaped and fashioned another (1035) body with bones, tendons, flesh, veins, and skin. And it bound that (part) of (1040) the light and good grace of the gods that the misbirths of the monsters had infiltrated through the fruits and êwar ('yw'r) (1045) in that body as soul. And it fitted inside it and filled into it even more than in Gehmurd its own desire, lust and, copulation and (1050) animosity and bad-mouthing, hate and sin, rage and *pollution and tidar (tyd'r) and mindlessness and (1055) antireligionism and doubt, thieving and lying, robbing and evil-doing, obstinacy and (1060) caburagi (cbwrgyyh), vengefulness and cêbag (cyybg), sorrow

poverty and (1065) destitution, illness and old age, stench and 'prgyy and all kinds of heresies and sinning.

{y.46} And those words and sounds (1075) of all those aborted monsters, from which it was shaped, those it gave to that female too, so that it too should speak and know (1080) various words. {Two lines left blank}

{y.47} And (the female) was also formed and shaped after that female appearance (1085) of the gods that it had seen from the chariot, and, from above, it connected to it (1090) from the heaven (its) beginning from and attachment to the monsters and Archons and the star signs and the planets, so that (1095) from the monsters and the star signs desire and sin should rain upon it and fill its mind (nous), so that it would become even (1100) more thieving and monstrous and lusty and desirous and seduce that male with desire and people be born in the world (1105) from those two creatures and be filled with concupiscence and desire and behave (1110) with rage and vengeance and without mercy and strike water and fire, trees and fruits and serve concupiscence and desire and do the will of the demons and go to hell. {Two lines left blank}

(1120) {y.48} Afterward, when that female creature was born, then they called it "female of the glories," that is (1125) Murdiyanag (wife of the (living) dead). And when those two creatures, male and female, had been born into the world and been raised and (1130) become bigger, then Az and the demons and the Archons were mighty happy. And that leader (1135) of the Archons called an assembly of the monsters and Archons and said to the two humans, "I created earth and (1140) heaven, sun and moon, water and fire, trees and fruits, wild animals and (other) creatures for your sake, so that thereby you may rejoice (1145) in the world and be content and happy and do my will."

{y.50} And (1150) a dragon, monstrous and terrible, he set over these two children as a guard (thinking): 'He shall protect them and not allow (1155) anybody to lead them away from us. For these monsters and Asreshtars fear the gods (1160) and are afraid that they should come over us and strike us or bind us. For these (1165) two children have been formed and built after the appearance and form of the gods." {Two lines left blank}

{y.51} Afterward, when that first man and female of the glories, the first man and woman, (1175) began to move about on the earth, then the Az in them awoke, and rage filled them, and they (1180) began to dig wells and strike trees and plants and move about on the earth in a rage (1185) and be concupiscent. And they do not fear the gods. And they do not recognize the five Mahraspands, (1190) which the world is arranged from, and they ceaselessly harm them. {Two lines left blank}

(1195) Afterward, because of { ... gap of unknown length}

[M7983 II/V-R/Hd] The speech about soul and corpse

[M7983 II/R/i]
(1197) {y.52} [ ... ] comes to it, his soul grows in life, strength, light, beauty (1200) and excellence and in (due) time is born. {Two lines left blank}

{y.53} And when he is born, (1205) then he is nurtured and lives in body and soul through that same nhwn of the demons and the mixture of the gods and comes to maturity. And he becomes a garment of Āz and for desire a cover. And he strikes water and fire and trees (1215) and creatures, his own family, and harms it. And that makes Az and desire happy, because he does their (1220) will and direction. But it makes neither water, nor fire, neither trees nor creatures happy, because he is (1225) their enemy and tormentor, and he does not realize that Az keeps him mindless and damned. (1230) And until the time and star sign under which that misbirth was born, no oppression comes upon it from the helpers who are above it. (But) then, at last, that misbirth lives and moves about, and when their hate (1240) and oppression come upon it, then the misbirth dies. And it is pulled up, and for its own acts (1245) it suffers punishment. And mankind, male and female, who are born in the universe have all been shaped by Az. (1250) {Two lines left blank}

{y.54} And from the water and plants and various fruits (1255) that through mankind come to Az and *are eaten by that Az, by its own deceit, then fashions (1260) and shapes misbirths from it. And as long as the water and plants remain in various places in mountains and plains and have not come to Āz and (1265) mankind, then mankind is not born from them. But when they have come to mankind (1270) then Az by its own dissimulation fashions and shapes misbirths from them. For, like a builder who (1275) wishes to build a palace and by his own knowledge assigns (what is needed) from the various materials of the palace to each room (1280) and each door and (then) builds (them), or like a tailor who by his own insight makes (1285) a garment from various stuff, and like a painter who by his own talent paints a picture from various colors. {Two lines left blank}

{y.55} And as long as the materials for the palace and the stuff (1295) for the garment and the color for the painting, which those craftsmen fit together (1300) and build and sow and paint, is in various places and the individual pieces have (1305) not been fitted together with their own parts, then they are not considered as either palace or garment or picture. (1310) But when the craftsmen by their own care fit together each item of the materials and the stuff and the color to their own product, well, (1315) then they build and sow and paint the palace and the garment and the image. And afterward (1320) they are assembled and become visible. {Two lines left blank}

{y.56} In the same manner that accursed (1325) Az, which fashions and shapes male and female misbirths, [assigns (what is needed)] from the nhwwn of the demons and from the mixture (1330) of the gods, which is mingled with water and plants, [to the various parts of mankind, and mankind is assembled and becomes visible.] ...
